root_cause: Timeout of downstream dependency search_service correlated with request HTTP 504 (dependency.success=false). Underlying infrastructure cause is uncertain.
recommended_checks: Inspect search_service logs for the time window around the request to identify timeouts or internal errors.
Check network/gateway logs and metrics between the application and search_service for connectivity issues or packet drops.
Review search_service resource utilization (CPU, memory, thread pools) and recent deployments or configuration changes.
Correlate distributed traces/spans for the request to see where time was spent and whether retries or queueing occurred.
Check monitoring/alerts for elevated latency or error rates on search_service and any concurrent incidents or scaling events.
